faqs.question: What does the AFB Rapid Culture by Bactec Fx – Bone Marrow test measure?
faqs.answer: This test detects Mycobacterium tuberculosis (MTB Complex) or Non-tuberculosis bacteria (NTM or MOTT) in the bone marrow sample.

faqs.question: Why is the AFB Rapid Culture by Bactec Fx – Bone Marrow test done?
faqs.answer: • To diagnose infection by Mycobacterium tuberculosis or Non-tuberculosis bacteria • To determine the effectiveness of treatment for these infections • To monitor the progress of the infection and response to therapy • To identify the specific bacteria causing the infection • To guide the selection of appropriate antibiotic treatment

faqs.question: When is the AFB Rapid Culture by Bactec Fx – Bone Marrow test recommended and who should take the test?
faqs.answer: This test is recommended when your doctor suspects an infection caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis or Non-tuberculosis bacteria. It is usually performed if you have symptoms such as persistent cough, fever, night sweats, weight loss, fatigue, or if you have been exposed to someone with tuberculosis.

faqs.question: What if the results of the AFB Rapid Culture by Bactec Fx – Bone Marrow test are abnormal?
faqs.answer: Abnormal results may indicate the presence of an infection caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis or Non-tuberculosis bacteria.

faqs.question: What to expect during the AFB Rapid Culture by Bactec Fx – Bone Marrow test?
faqs.answer: During the test: • A small amount of bone marrow will be collected using a needle. • The sample will be sent to the laboratory for testing.

faqs.question: What preparations are required before the AFB Rapid Culture by Bactec Fx – Bone Marrow test?
faqs.answer: Before the test: • Ensure that your clinical history, including symptoms and relevant information, is properly mentioned on the test request form. • Follow any specific instructions provided by your doctor regarding fasting or medication restrictions. • The bone marrow sample will be collected during a separate procedure under aseptic conditions. Please reach out to your healthcare provider for any specific requirements.

faqs.question: What other tests may be ordered with the AFB Rapid Culture by Bactec Fx – Bone Marrow test?
faqs.answer: Additional tests that may be performed alongside the AFB Rapid Culture by Bactec Fx – Bone Marrow test include: • Acid-Fast Bacillus (AFB) smear microscopy • GeneXpert Mycobacterium tuberculosis/Rifampicin Resistance test • Chest X-ray or CT scan These tests help provide a comprehensive evaluation of the infection and its impact on overall health.

faqs.question: What is the AFB Rapid Culture by Bactec Fx – Bone Marrow test also known as?
faqs.answer: Bone Marrow Culture for Mycobacterium Tuberculosis and Non-Tuberculosis Mycobacteria (NTM).

faqs.question: What is tuberculosis?
faqs.answer: Tuberculosis (TB) is a contagious bacterial infection caused by Mycobacterium tuberculosis. It primarily affects the lungs but can also affect other parts of the body. Early diagnosis and treatment are crucial for effective management.
